🎥🚔: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The Vermont state troopers are back—and somehow, things are even more chaotic than before. This time, Farva’s ridiculously over-the-top engagement to Thorny’s sister has the entire crew caught up in wedding madness, with everyone trying to keep the big day from completely falling apart.

But the celebration takes an unexpected turn when the troopers stumble into an investigation involving a dangerous new drug ring. What follows is classic Super Troopers chaos: ridiculous pranks, questionable police work, absurd situations, and the kind of unpredictable humor that made the crew a cult favorite.

With the Broken Lizard gang reunited, Super Troopers 3 brings the friendship, mischief, and outrageous comedy back for another wild adventure.

In theatres August 7. Get tickets now at Searchlight Pictures.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
